greet.label: GREET
greet.prompt: Viewpoint from INSIDE the room looking toward the entrance: {{CUSTOMER}} stands in the open {{DOORWAY}}, framed by it, facing the viewer and waving as they step in over the threshold — the moment of arriving and greeting, seen from within the room they are entering.

leave.label: LEAVE
leave.prompt: {{CUSTOMER}} stepping OUT through the {{DOORWAY}}, facing away with an over-the-shoulder wave — the moment of leaving and saying goodbye. The outward direction (leaving, not entering) is what makes this a farewell.

ground_beef.label: GROUND_BEEF
ground_beef.prompt: {{GROUND_MEAT}} on its white butcher paper, with the {{BEEF_ICON}} printed as a single clear stamp on the paper beside the meat — marking this minced meat as beef.

meat_by_weight.label: MEAT_BY_WEIGHT
meat_by_weight.prompt: {{GROUND_MEAT}} resting on the pan of the {{SCALE}}, the dial's needle pointing to a mark on the gram face — meat being weighed, ordered by weight.

cafe.label: CAFE
cafe.prompt: A small café interior. A wooden counter runs along the front, its top clear. Behind it, the {{ESPRESSO_MACHINE}} on the back counter, a glass case of breakfast pastries, cups stacked on a shelf, and a chalkboard on the wall. The chalkboard is handwritten in chalk in Slovene and reads, line by line: Danes posebej:, then rogljiček, then kremšnita. No other text or lettering appears anywhere in the image. No people.

bakery.label: BAKERY
bakery.prompt: A welcoming bakery interior. A wooden counter runs along the front, its top clear. Behind it, wall shelves of bread and pastries with a {{POTICA}} on a cake stand, a basket of loaves on the floor, and a chalkboard on the wall. The chalkboard is handwritten in chalk in Slovene and reads, line by line: Danes posebej:, then potica, then gibanica. No other text or lettering appears anywhere in the image. No people.

mesnica.label: MESNICA
mesnica.prompt: A welcoming butcher shop interior. A counter runs along the front, its top clear. Behind it, a refrigerated glass-and-steel display case of meat, a ring of {{SAUSAGES}} hanging on a rail above, white tiled walls and a steel work surface. No people.

lekarna.label: LEKARNA
lekarna.prompt: A pharmacy (lekarna) interior. A wooden counter runs along the front; behind it, white shelves of medicine boxes line the back wall, with a pack of {{TABLETS}} and a few coins on the counter. No people.
